feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 11 September 2026 5:13am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 11 September 2026 at 5:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds later.


##Synopsis##

High pressure near the Azores extends a ridge across the area.


##Wind##

West or Northwest 4 or 5, decreasing 3 or 4 by midday, then backing West or Southwest through the afternoon. Increasing South or Southwest 4 or 5 in the evening, then 5 to 7 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate at first, building moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain and drizzle spread from the west later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or Southwest 5 to 7, decreasing Southwest 4 to 6 early afternoon tomorrow, then 3 or 4 in the evening. Veering Westerly 2 to 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, occasionally rough, falling slight later.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle, becoming mainly fair later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.
